youtube.baslik: Audiologists in Türkiye: Legal Definition and Scope | Lesson 284 | AIHEAR Audiology Academy
youtube.aciklama:
How is an audiologist legally defined in Türkiye? In this lesson we learn Additional Article 13 of Law No. 1219, the 2014 Regulation on the job and duty definitions of health professionals, the difference in duties between the audiologist and the audiometry technician, and how to answer scope of practice questions. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.

AIHEAR Audiology Academy makes short, clear lessons for audiology students and professionals.

Sources: Law No. 1219 on the Practice of Medicine and Its Branches, Additional Article 13 (added by Law No. 6225, 2011); Regulation on the Job and Duty Definitions of Health Professionals and Other Professionals Working in Health Services (Official Gazette, May 22, 2014, No. 29007; current text in the Legislation Information System).

This video is for educational purposes and does not replace diagnosis or treatment.

cumleler: Hello, and welcome to the AIHEAR Audiology Academy.
In this lesson we examine the legal definition and scope of practice of audiologists in Türkiye, using the texts of the law itself.

cumleler.yazi: We will look at Law No. 1219, the 2014 duty definitions regulation, and how the audiologist differs from the audiometry technician.
cumleler.ses: We will look at Law number twelve nineteen, the twenty fourteen duty definitions regulation, and how the audiologist differs from the audiometry technician.

cumleler: A profession's legal framework is built in layers; at the top are the laws passed by the Grand National Assembly of Türkiye.
Based on the authority a law grants, ministries publish regulations that set out the details.
Circulars and directives then describe in more detail how things are to be done in practice.
At the bottom are your institution's own procedures and clinical protocols; these cannot contradict higher legislation.
Laws and regulations are published in the Official Gazette; current texts with amendments are in the Legislation Information System.
This lesson is not legal advice; legislation can change, so always check the current text.

cumleler.yazi: Law No. 1219 on the Practice of Medicine and Its Branches was passed in 1928 and published in the Official Gazette the same year.
cumleler.ses: Law number twelve nineteen on the Practice of Medicine and Its Branches was passed in nineteen twenty-eight and published in the Official Gazette the same year.

cumleler: The Law is the core text governing how medicine and the health-related professions are practiced.

cumleler.yazi: In 2011, Additional Article 13 was added to the Law by Law No. 6225.
cumleler.ses: In twenty eleven, Additional Article 13 was added to the Law by Law number sixty-two twenty-five.

cumleler: This additional article defines, one by one, many health professionals, such as the clinical psychologist, physiotherapist and audiologist.
The audiologist is defined in clause (c) of this article; so audiology became a health profession recognized by law.
The additional article was amended by other laws in later years, so the text should always be read in its current form.

maddeler.metin: Bachelor's or graduate degree in audiology
Hearing and balance checks in healthy people

cumleler: Under the Law, an audiologist is a graduate of a faculty or school that offers a bachelor's degree in audiology.
Those who complete a master's or doctorate in audiology after another bachelor's degree are also included in the definition.
The audiologist performs hearing and balance checks in healthy people.
Working to prevent hearing disorders is also part of the legal definition.
On the referral of the relevant specialist physician for diagnosis or treatment, the audiologist identifies hearing and balance disorders.
The audiologist rehabilitates these disorders and determines the devices used for these purposes.
Two separate areas stand out in the definition: prevention and screening in healthy people, and work on physician referral in disease.
Clause (m) of the same article defines the audiometry technician as a graduate of an associate degree program in audiometry.
The audiometry technician performs the necessary tests, using the relevant equipment, on patients whose indication has been set.
So the decision to test is made elsewhere; the technician turns that decision into an accurate and reliable measurement.
The Law classes the audiometry technician as a health technician.
The profession often called audiometrist in the clinic appears in the legislation under this name, as audiometry technician.
We will set the duties of the two professions side by side after looking at the regulation.
Under Additional Article 13, health professionals other than physicians and dentists cannot plan treatment by making a direct diagnosis.
Under the same provision, these professionals also cannot write prescriptions.
So diagnosis, the treatment plan and prescriptions are the responsibility of physicians and dentists.
This is why the audiologist does not make a diagnosis in the report; they describe the findings and what the findings are consistent with.
This is the legal basis for the distinction between interpretation and diagnosis we saw in the audiological report lesson.
The Law also states that the detailed job and duty definitions of health professionals will be set by a Ministry of Health regulation.

cumleler.yazi: The regulation based on this authority was published in the Official Gazette of May 22, 2014, No. 29007.
cumleler.ses: The regulation based on this authority was published in the Official Gazette of May twenty-second, twenty fourteen, number two nine zero zero seven.

cumleler: Its full title is the Regulation on the Job and Duty Definitions of Health Professionals and Other Professionals Working in Health Services.
The purpose of the regulation is to set out the job and duty definitions of these professionals.
Under Article 6, the duty definitions of health professionals, by title, are in Annex 1.
The duties of other professionals working in health services are in Annex 2.

cumleler.yazi: The regulation was amended in 2021, 2024 and 2025; so duty definitions should be read from the current text.
cumleler.ses: The regulation was amended in twenty twenty-one, twenty twenty-four and twenty twenty-five; so duty definitions should be read from the current text.

cumleler: The first duty in Annex 1 is performing diagnostic tests for hearing and balance disorders on the referral of a specialist physician.
The same item also covers rehabilitation, and determining, selecting and programming devices for hearing rehabilitation.
The audiologist works to protect hearing health and to prevent hearing loss.
They take part in hearing screening programs and perform the tests in these programs.
They carry out noise measurements and make the recommendations needed to protect hearing.
When the surgeon considers it necessary, they perform hearing and balance nerve monitoring during surgery.
For devices implanted in the ear, they set the device during and after surgery.

maddeler.metin: Read the Law and Regulation together

cumleler: The audiologist performs auditory processing assessments.
Auditory processing rehabilitation is also in the duty definition; the practices we saw in the auditory training lessons are examples.
The audiologist also takes part in preparing hearing-related training programs.
Reading the Law's definition together with the Regulation's list of duties reveals the audiologist's scope of practice.
When a new practice not on the list comes up, the views of your institution and professional organizations should be sought.
The first difference between the two professions is education: the audiologist has a bachelor's degree, the technician an associate degree.
Under Annex 1, the audiometry technician performs pure-tone, speech and immittance tests and records the results on the test form.
Vestibular tests and otoacoustic emission testing, however, are done under the supervision of the relevant specialist physician.
The technician takes ear impressions, measures the gain and output of the devices deemed suitable, and adjusts them.
Determining and selecting the device, auditory processing assessment and rehabilitation are in the audiologist's duty definition.
Both take part in screening programs and noise measurements; in the clinic, the best results come from the two working together.
In hospitals, the audiologist carries out diagnostic testing and rehabilitation together with the ear, nose and throat team.
Hearing aid centers are governed by separate rules; we will look at them in the next lesson.
On the cochlear implant team, measurements during surgery and later programming are among the audiologist's duties.
In newborn and school-age screening programs, the audiologist both tests and monitors the quality of the program.
In workplaces, noise measurement and hearing monitoring are an important area we saw in the occupational health lessons.
Universities carry out teaching and research; we will cover career paths separately in our last lesson.
If you are unsure whether a task is within your scope, first look at the definition in the Law.
Then check the current duty list in the Regulation.
Also review your institution's authorizations and protocols; some practices may require extra certification or a written protocol.
Even for legally permitted work, question your own training and competence; this is the competence principle from the ethics lesson.
If the answer is unclear, referring the patient to the relevant specialist without delay is the safest path.
These questions protect both the patient and you; knowing the limits of your authority is the basis of professional trust.

sahneler.metin: In reports, use a finding and consistency sentence instead of a diagnosis, such as "findings consistent with a cochlear site"; diagnosis and treatment belong to the physician.
cumleler: A clinical tip: write the interpretation section of your report with the legal definition in mind.
Instead of saying "this patient has otosclerosis," saying "findings are consistent with a conductive hearing loss" is within your scope.
Then write your recommendation clearly, such as "an ear, nose and throat assessment is recommended."
This way you both show the patient the right path and stay within the limits of your authority.

cumleler.yazi: The audiologist is a health professional defined in Additional Article 13 of Law No. 1219, added in 2011.
cumleler.ses: The audiologist is a health professional defined in Additional Article 13 of Law number twelve nineteen, added in twenty eleven.

cumleler: Health professionals other than physicians and dentists cannot make a direct diagnosis, plan treatment or write prescriptions.

cumleler.yazi: The detailed duties are in Annex 1 of the 2014 job and duty definitions regulation and are followed in the current text.
cumleler.ses: The detailed duties are in Annex 1 of the twenty fourteen job and duty definitions regulation and are followed in the current text.

cumleler: The audiometry technician has an associate degree and performs set tests; device selection and rehabilitation are the audiologist's duties.

sahneler.aciklama: Under Law No. 1219, health professionals _other than physicians and dentists_ cannot write prescriptions.

cumleler.yazi: Test yourself: under Law No. 1219, who has the authority to write prescriptions?
cumleler.ses: Test yourself: under Law number twelve nineteen, who has the authority to write prescriptions?

cumleler: The correct answer is C: physicians and dentists.
The audiologist assesses and reports findings; diagnosis, the treatment plan and prescriptions belong to the physician.
